body_md:
Turns the engine on. From the next UTC day an outcome is owed every night (07:17 UTC run), the watchdog marks
missed nights FAILED, and the week is published every Monday from 01:00 New York time (GitHub Release, Zenodo
versions for approved projects, at most one LinkedIn post that clears the announcement bar).

Before answering yes, it is worth running one nightly **drill** (Actions → nightly → Run workflow → drill) and
checking its `drill-verify` artifact. Pausing later is one more decision (`pause_schedule`).
title: Activate the nightly schedule and weekly publication
